# Vue.js Agent Package

This package supports Vue 3 applications using Composition API and TypeScript.

## Agents

- `agents/vue-orchestrator.agent.md`: planning, routing, analysis, and delivery.
- `agents/vue-ui.agent.md`: Atomic Design, Design Analysis, and UI Layout Generation.
- `agents/vue-app.agent.md`: routing, guards, services, and composables.
- `agents/vue-api.agent.md`: API, authentication, validation, and errors.
- `agents/vue-state.agent.md`: Pinia and composable state.
- `agents/vue-db.agent.md`: models, DTOs, schemas, and data boundaries.
- `agents/vue-qa.agent.md`: unit/integration, accessibility, Playwright, and release QA.

Default standards include WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 with WCAG 2.2 Level AA as the target, compatible test-runner reuse with Vitest fallback, and cross-browser/responsive evidence.
